comment: AISI/SAE 1018 low-carbon steel, cold drawn. Density 7.85 g/cm3: Wikipedia 'Carbon steel' (mild steel, approximately 7.85 g/cm3). Hardness 126 HB: typical value of public cold-drawn 1018 datasheets (MatWeb), not re-checked here. kc1.1 1700 N/mm2: approximate, ISO 513 group P (low-carbon steel) order of magnitude. Cutting data for this material are in the tools' presets.
name: 1018 (cold drawn)
